lines.en: Swinging the blessed cup, it walks lightly.
Surrounded by holy light, it walks slowly.
Holding the cup, it walks slowly.
Guided by holy light, it walks lightly.

lines.zh: 它捧着圣杯，绕着主人走半圈。
lines.en: Cup in hand, it circles half a turn around its owner.

lines.zh: 它边走边撒下细碎的光。
lines.en: It walks and scatters bits of light behind it.

lines.zh: 它把圣杯举高，接住一点日光。
lines.en: It lifts the cup to catch a little sunlight.

lines.zh: 它低声念着治伤的祷词。
它把圣水点在同伴的额头。
lines.en: It dabs holy water on a companion's brow.

lines.zh: 它检查自己的袍角有没有破。
lines.en: It checks the hem of its robe for tears.
It counts the pages in the tome.
It waits quietly for someone to get hurt.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，圣光环绕

lines.en: Stares at player, cup in hand.
Stares at player, cup in hand.

lines.zh: 它抬眼看你，杯里的光晃了晃。
lines.en: It looks up, and the light in the cup wavers.
It works out where you are bleeding.

lines.zh: 它把圣杯朝你的方向倾了倾。
lines.en: It tips the cup toward you.
It studies you, as if measuring a dose.

lines.zh: 它对你点头，圣光随之一亮。
lines.en: It nods at you and the holy light brightens.
It frowns at an old wound of yours.
It reaches out to touch your injury.

lines.zh: 它的目光落在你的手上。
lines.en: Its gaze settles on your hands.

lines.zh: 它在你身边低语，试图让你接近它。
lines.en: It whispers near you, tempting you to get closer.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着引诱的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes shine with an enticing light.

lines.zh: 它用圣洁的光芒吸引你的注意。
lines.en: It draws your attention with holy radiance.

lines.zh: 它轻轻触碰你的手，希望被你驯服。
lines.en: It gently touches your hand, hoping to be tamed.

lines.zh: 它发出悦耳的吟唱，让你无法抗拒。
lines.en: It sings a sweet melody, making you irresistible.

lines.zh: 它的存在使周围的空气都充满诱惑。
lines.en: Its presence makes the air around you alluring.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中透露出渴望被理解的情感。
lines.en: Its eyes show a desire to be understood.

lines.zh: 它用温柔的触碰让你感到安心。
lines.en: It touches you gently, making you feel at ease.

lines.zh: 它以神秘的方式接近你。
lines.en: It approaches you in a mysterious way.

lines.zh: 它的存在让你感到被祝福的感觉。
lines.en: Its presence makes you feel blessed.
Suddenly, it appears in front of you.

lines.zh: 它的到来让你措手不及。
lines.en: Its arrival takes you by surprise.
It collides with your body suddenly.

lines.zh: 你感到一阵强烈的冲击。
它的撞击让你措手不及。
lines.en: Its collision takes you off guard.

lines.zh: 它的力量让你难以抵挡。
lines.en: Its power is hard to resist.

lines.zh: 它以惊人的速度冲向你。
lines.en: It rushes at you with incredible speed.
You are pushed back by it.
It longs to be your partner.

lines.zh: 它用温柔的方式吸引你。

lines.en: It sends you a signal of love.
It hopes to share its life with you.

lines.zh: 它邀请你进行心灵的交流。
lines.en: It invites you for a heart-to-heart.

lines.zh: 它用温暖的触碰表达情感。
lines.en: It expresses its feelings with warm touches.
It is willing to fly with you.

lines.zh: 它向你展示深情的意愿。
lines.en: It shows its deep desire for you.
It wishes to journey with you.

lines.zh: 你感受到圣光的温暖了吗？
lines.en: Feel the warmth of holy light.

lines.zh: 来吧，让我们一起吟诵咒语吧。

lines.en: May you gain strength and courage.
You are my light of protection.
Cure the wounds, protect your allies.
Guard your companions, give them healing.

lines.zh: 它把圣杯举到胸前，开始祷告。
lines.en: It raises the cup to its chest and prays.

lines.zh: 它退到你身后，准备支援。
lines.en: It falls back behind you to support.
Target the enemy, cast the spell.
Target the victim, heal the wound.
Target the target, give them strength.
Target the target, cast the magic.

lines.zh: 它把祝福落在你的刀上。
lines.en: It lays a blessing on your blade.

lines.zh: 它闭眼，光聚在它的掌心。
lines.en: It closes its eyes and light pools in its palm.
It flings the holy water in an arc.

lines.zh: 它抬手，光顺着地面爬过去。
lines.en: It lifts a hand and light creeps along the ground.
Magic forms a sword of light!

lines.zh: 我来了，准备迎接战斗吧！
lines.en: Here I am, ready for battle!
Blessed chalice activated, I am born!
Here I am, to protect this land!

lines.zh: 守护者的光辉，指引我到来！
圣杯里浮起一缕烟，成了它。
lines.en: Smoke rises from the cup and becomes it.

lines.zh: 它从魔宠床的光里坐起。
lines.en: It sits up out of the familiar bed's glow.

lines.zh: 宝典翻开，它落在书页上。
lines.en: The tome opens and it lands on the page.

lines.zh: 它以一声祈祷作为开场。
lines.en: It opens with a single prayer.

lines.zh: 我的圣光，也要靠食物点着。
lines.en: Even my holy light needs food to burn.

lines.zh: 雷光穿过我的祝福圣杯。
lines.en: Lightning runs through my blessed chalice.
